event: Vermont Green FC defeated Laredo Heat SC 7-1 in the USL League Two National Semifinal, advancing to the final with an undefeated record through the season and playoffs.
Head Coach Chris Taylor's unbeaten streak reached 41 matches with the semifinal win; the club recorded its 10th consecutive victory, the longest in club history.
Flint City Bucks defeated Ventura County Fusion 1-0 in the USL League Two National Semifinal on a late Oliver Moller-Jensen goal, advancing to their seventh League Two Final.
Laredo Heat SC eliminated from the 2026 USL League Two playoffs following a 1-7 loss to Vermont Green FC in the National Semifinal.
Ventura County Fusion eliminated from the 2026 USL League Two playoffs following a 0-1 loss to Flint City Bucks in the National Semifinal.

Rhode Island FC loaned midfielder Clay Holstad to MLS club FC Dallas for the remainder of the 2026 season, with an option for a permanent transfer; Holstad is the first RIFC player to earn an MLS move.
Expansion club Atlético Dallas signed Javier 'Chicharito' Hernández, Mexico's all-time leading scorer, to a two-year deal with a club option for a third year as their first-ever player signing.
Chicharito signing is the expansion club's first confirmed roster move ahead of their inaugural USL Championship season.
Charlotte Independence defeated Corpus Christi FC 2-1, extending their winning run to four games per season records through July 2.
Corpus Christi FC lost 1-2 to Charlotte Independence, remaining winless through their first 10+ League One matches of the 2026 season.
Chattanooga Red Wolves SC won 2-0 at home against Westchester SC, continuing their competitive form in the 2026 League One season.
Westchester SC lost 0-2 to Chattanooga Red Wolves, extending what the season records describe as an ongoing losing run in 2026 League One.
Forward Madison FC won 1-0 away at Spokane Velocity FC, collecting a road win in USL League One play.

Deportivo Rose City defeated Next Level Soccer 2-1 in the UPSL West Region Final to qualify for the UPSL Spring 2026 National Finals in Los Angeles, carrying a 2027 US Open Cup berth into the semifinal.
NY Renegades FC qualified for the UPSL Spring 2026 National Finals in Los Angeles (Aug. 7-9) by winning the East Region, setting up a rematch of the 2025 UPSL Fall Final against Miami United FC.
Miami United FC advanced through the UPSL South Region Final via penalty shootout (6-5) over SCU Heat to qualify for the UPSL Spring 2026 National Finals in Los Angeles.
Central Kansas United qualified for the UPSL Spring 2026 National Finals in Los Angeles, advancing from the Central Region to face Deportivo Rose City in the semifinal.
SCU Heat eliminated from the UPSL Spring 2026 playoffs via penalty shootout (5-6) loss to Miami United FC in the South Region Final.
Vermont Green FC confirmed as finalist in the 2026 USL League Two National Final, with the club having also won the 2026 Steinbrecher Cup and reached the second round of the US Open Cup this season.
